paper_title: A torsion-balance search for ultra low-mass bosonic dark matter
notes: Eot-Wash stationary torsion balance (Be-Al composition dipole) search for B-L coupled ultralight vector DM, masses 1e-18 to 1e-16 eV. Only one explicit numerical point given in text: best limit g_BL(hbar c)^{-1/2} < 1e-25 at m = 8e-18 eV (near resonance f0 = 1.934 mHz). Other data_points are reconstructed from the paper's stated scaling: limits scale as 1/sqrt(f) below resonance and as f above resonance; treat as approximate (Fig. 5 not digitizable from text). Paper also gives B-coupled limits in appendix (Fig. 6), not extracted here. DM density rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
